primary_gameplan: Cycle cyclers to fill the graveyard, hold Force of Negation for their first noncreature spell (especially Vexing Bauble), and cascade into Living End once the graveyard is loaded and no live counter-hate is on their battlefield.
secondary_gameplan: If the cascade window closes (Vexing Bauble or Drannith Magistrate resolves), fall back to Endurance/Subtlety/Wistfulness as flash bodies and disruption while digging for artifact/enchantment answers to clear the hate piece.
opponent_gameplan: Devoted Druid taps for green mana and untaps itself for the cost of a -1/-1 counter; Vizier of Remedies reduces that counter to zero, so the loop is free and repeatable, producing infinite green mana with no doubler required. Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm tutor whichever half is missing, or go straight to Craterhoof Behemoth for a hasty lethal swing off a board of dorks.
pitfalls: Cascading with a live Vexing Bauble on their battlefield -- the cascaded Living End is cast without paying its mana cost (Violent Outburst/Shardless Agent oracle text) and gets countered outright.
Firing Force of Negation at a mana dork instead of holding it for Vexing Bauble, Leyline of Abundance, or a tutor -- Force of Negation cannot target a creature spell at all.
Evoking Endurance purely for its graveyard-strip mode -- their engine is entirely on-board (Devoted Druid + Vizier), so stripping their graveyard buys little; evoke it for the 3/4 reach body instead.

Boarding in Tormod's Crypt against this matchup -- it is mana value 0, a valid cascade target below Violent Outburst/Shardless Agent's mana value 3, and this archetype's own engine wants graveyards full (Agatha's Soul Cauldron), so it answers nothing here while adding a cascade-collision risk.

CORRECTED 2026-08-24. This pitfall previously read that Damping Matrix is symmetric_counter because CR 702.29b keeps the cycling ability alive in every zone, and therefore shuts our own Street Wraith / Curator of Mysteries / Generous Ent / Oliphaunt / Colossal Skyturtle / Waker of Waves. That is WRONG on two counts and it contradicted both this wiki's own `matchups/broodscale-bloodchief.json` and the `creatures toolbox` row of `boarding-plan.json`. First, the rules: Damping Matrix reads 'Activated abilities of artifacts and creatures can't be activated unless they're mana abilities'. It names no zone and uses none of the words 'card', 'spell', 'source' or 'scheme', so CR 109.2 scopes 'creatures' to permanents, and CR 403.3 says permanents exist only on the battlefield. A Street Wraith being cycled is a creature CARD in a hand (CR 110.4a), not a creature, so Damping Matrix does not reach it. CR 702.29b says only that the cycling ability continues to EXIST in other zones so effects can see it; it does not put the card into the set of objects CR 109.2 built, which is the set Damping Matrix restricts. Second, the card list: Colossal Skyturtle has no cycling at all (two Channel abilities) and Waker of Waves has no cycling either (a plain '{1}{U}, Discard this card:' ability), so CR 702.29b never governed them. Damping Matrix is a `counter` for this 75, not a `symmetric_counter`. It remains a PARTIAL answer to this engine for a different reason, recorded on the `devoted combo` row: Devoted Druid's '{T}: Add {G}' is a mana ability and survives, Badgermole Cub's and Leyline of Abundance's 'whenever you tap a creature for mana' clauses are triggered abilities and survive, and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler's '+1: Untap up to one target creature' is a planeswalker loyalty ability the Matrix never mentions.

hands_keep.reason: no cascade spell, but three free-cast disruption pieces (Wistfulness, Subtlety, Endurance) plus two cyclers to dig -- keepable specifically because this matchup rewards holding up interaction for Vexing Bauble/their finisher while digging toward a cascade spell, not because it satisfies the deck's baseline keepable predicate (which requires a cascade card).

hands_mulligan.reason: two copies of Living End and no cascade enabler -- the deck's own keepable predicate caps Living End at max 1 in decks/living-end/evidence-spec.json because a second copy is dead without a cascade spell to find it, and against a deck racing to a same-turn infinite-mana kill a hand that cannot cascade for several turns is too slow.

stance_rationale: RETIRED LABEL -- read the `devoted combo` row instead. statistics_decks returns zero decks under this archetype id (c22029ff-3de2-424e-85bc-c270daf9558a) dated on or after 2026-08-13: the archetype was relabelled `devoted combo` (c4fc27b7-4e36-4b08-a070-4d5824a6d1a6), the two ids overlap only on 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-12, and 10 recent top-8 lists per label carry an identical 28-card four-of core. This row survives only because boarding_field.py derives the field from the committed fingerprint and the fingerprint still counts 43 decks under this id. Everything below is frozen at 2026-08-12 and two reads have already moved: Drannith Magistrate was in 9 of 10 boards and is now in 0 of 10, and Abrupt Decay was in 0 of 10 and is now in 8 of 10. On the merits, unchanged: Force of Vigor (kills Vexing Bauble / Leyline of Abundance / Agatha's Soul Cauldron) and Dismember (kills Devoted Druid / Vizier of Remedies before the loop assembles) attack their engine directly at no cost to our own cascade plan; both are mana value 3-4, safely clear of the cascade floor. Damping Matrix is boarded here too and is a `counter`, not a `symmetric_counter` -- the earlier claim in pitfall #5 that it disabled our own cycling was a rules error and is corrected there.

play_plan.keep: A hand with disruption (Force of Negation/Subtlety/Wistfulness) or two-plus cyclers even without a cascade spell; a pure cascade-only hand risks a live Vexing Bauble or Drannith Magistrate.
play_plan.goldfish_for: A second land plus a cascade spell while holding Force of Negation for their first noncreature spell.
play_plan.watch_for: Whether they tap out for Leyline of Abundance or Green Sun's Zenith on turn two or three -- that signals the combo is one turn away and Force of Negation should stay in hand, not fire at a dork.
play_plan.posture_why: Their kill is faster than ours once the loop assembles, so denying Vexing Bauble and the combo pieces before cascading wins, not racing.

opponent_plan.posture_why: Devoted Druid plus Vizier of Remedies is a same-turn infinite-mana kill once assembled, so outracing our turn 4-6 cascade clock is the plan, not attrition.
